newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: YPF sells 10 pct of shares at $29.25 - underwriter.
newsitem.headline: YPF sells 10 pct of shares at $29.25 - underwriter.

text.p: Argentine oil firm YPF sold the 10 percent of its shares held by employees at a cut-off price of $29.25 each, Banco Comafi, one of the underwriters, said Wednesday.
"The deal went very well," Comafi spokesman Eduardo Maschwitz told Reuters. "They were over-subscribed."
Maschwitz added that most bidders were long-term investors such as pension funds, mutual funds, and insurance companies.
The deal received the green light Tuesday night when an Argentine judge modified an earlier ruling and allowed the sale of the shares, after YPF made a deposit of $400,000 in guarantees to the court.

The judge on Monday had ordered the deal suspended following a complaint by 11 former YPF employees who said they were left out of the Shared Property Program created when the oil giant was privatized in 1993.
Merchant Bankers Asociados, an Argentine affiliate of Salomon Brothers Inc, Salomon Brothers and U.S. Vestrust Securities LP are also underwriters of the deal.
